title: What stangent-view-writer returns (D416)
description: For each flow the input names (V1, V2, …): a short title for the journey and one plain line per step the input lists (S the start, A who may start it, C1… what it changes, X1… how it stops early). Code checks every line names one listed step, every step has a line, each is one sentence with no code name its step doesn't have.

flow.description: The flow's id as the input names it: V1, V2, …

title.description: The journey's name in plain words, as a product manager would say it ("Remove read items from a reading list"), at most 80 characters.

item.description: The step's id as the input lists it: S, A, C1…, X1…

text.description: One plain sentence for a product manager saying what this step means for the user: who may do it, what changes, or when it stops and what they see. No code names, no backticks, at most 200 characters.
